task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

values.instruction: Write a brief summary using about 1 to 3 sentences and roughly 30 to 40 words.
Write a longer summary using 4 or more sentences and 60 or more words.

axes.name: sentence_complexity
axes.description: 문장당 단어 수와 문장 구조의 복잡성을 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Use short and simple sentences with fewer than 15 words each.
Use sentences of moderate length, around 15 to 25 words, with clear structure.

axes.name: information_density
axes.description: 답변 내에서 정보가 얼마나 압축되어 있는지를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Include more background or explanatory information, making the summary less dense.
Include key facts and main points without excessive detail or elaboration.

axes.name: stance_and_objectivity
axes.description: 답변에서 주관적 의견이나 평가의 포함 여부를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Present information factually without adding personal opinions or subjective comments.
Include some evaluative or interpretive comments alongside factual information.
